findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name SSL Context Creation Analysis
 * @description Analyzes how SSL contexts are created to detect potential insecure configurations.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/ssl-context-analysis
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("create_default_context").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("_create_unverified_context").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("SSLContext").getACall()
select call, "SSL Context creation detected."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure SSL context creation might allow Man-in-the-Middle attacks.
User input flowing into HTTP headers without validation can lead to CRLF injection.
